description: This file implements a FastAPI web application serving a WebSocket chat interface with an HTML frontend, including WebSocket connection handling, dependency injection for cookies and query parameters, and WebSocket endpoint logic.

classes.description: The main application class used to create the FastAPI instance.

classes.description: Represents a WebSocket connection in FastAPI for handling WebSocket endpoints.

methods.description: WebSocket endpoint that accepts connections, receives messages, and echoes information back, including session data and query parameters.
